newsitem.title: USA: Dow seen opening lower as selling continues.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen opening lower as selling continues.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to open lower on Friday following a wave of selling late on Thursday that took the Dow down 150 points on the heaviest day of trading ever.
The losses, sparked by higher interest rates and negative technical indicators in the futures market, wiped out the Dow's first foray over the 6900 mark.
The Dow closed off 94 points to 6756.

"We should open down about 20 points or so," judging from the Standard & Poor's March futures contract, said Prudential Securities market analyst Larry Wachtel. He said he expected some further falls but then the market to stabilise.
